# PPR May 16 Release

_Category: Past Releases · Source: BC Registries API community forum_

**pheath** (5/16/2022):

**Ticket 12100 -** If amending a PPR Registration and copying existing General Collateral text from the registration, the General Collateral WYSIWYG editor will retain the same formatting for the pasted General Collateral text.

**Ticket 11001 -** Revised formatting has been applied to the Registration or Amendment draft screen print to improve readability. Draft registrations can be printed with CTRL/P from the Review and Confirm screen.
